column1: # Game profile of Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2, update v458752): Nintendo EPD's sead / agl / gsys engine on SDK 20.5.19 (Ounce) and NVN2, whose shaders are Ampere code.
# The heap region is the Switch 2's 9 GB, reserved, not committed: the game sets an 8.94 GB heap and touches what it uses (a 2.2 GB footprint at its first screens on an
# arm64 Android emulator, 2026-11-02). Gameplay's footprint is not measured yet; the pool is to be trimmed to that plus a margin for 12 GB devices
# agl's render buffer binding wraps its clears in render conditions (SetRenderEnableConditional before its ClearColor): drawn unconditionally, a clear-only rebinding of the
# composite target after the composite draw wiped it before the upscaler read it, and gameplay frames came out black
